<thought>Using the observed [M+H]+ ion at m/z 235.1395, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈ 234.132 Da. The formula C₁₄H₁₈O₃ matches this mass (calculated neutral mass = 234.1256 Da, giving an [M+H]+ of 235.1328 Da, within a few ppm of the measured value). No additional hetero‑atom is required, so the molecular formula is C14H18O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
